name: Build Signed APK (Bubblewrap TWA)

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
    paths:
      - 'twa-manifest.json'
      - '.github/workflows/build-apk.yml'
      - 'manifest.json'
      - 'icon-*.png'

  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release:
        description: 'Create a GitHub Release with the APK/AAB'
        required: false
        default: 'false'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build & Sign Android APK
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Set up Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
        with:
          packages: 'platforms;android-34 build-tools;34.0.0 platform-tools'

      - name: Set up Node.js 20
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Bubblewrap CLI
        run: npm install -g @bubblewrap/cli@latest

      - name: Pre-configure Bubblewrap (skip interactive prompts)
        run: |
          set -e
          echo "----- Env -----"
          echo "JAVA_HOME=$JAVA_HOME"
          echo "ANDROID_HOME=$ANDROID_HOME"
          echo "ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT"

          # Resolve SDK path: prefer ANDROID_HOME, fallback to ANDROID_SDK_ROOT
          SDK_PATH="${ANDROID_HOME:-$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT}"
          echo "Resolved SDK_PATH=$SDK_PATH"

          if [ -z "$SDK_PATH" ] || [ ! -d "$SDK_PATH" ]; then
            echo "::error::Android SDK path not found"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "----- SDK root contents -----"
          ls -la "$SDK_PATH"

          # Bubblewrap validates by checking for platform-tools/
          if [ ! -d "$SDK_PATH/platform-tools" ]; then
            echo "::error::platform-tools dir missing in SDK"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Export the resolved path for later steps
          echo "ANDROID_HOME=$SDK_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

          mkdir -p "$HOME/.bubblewrap"
          cat > "$HOME/.bubblewrap/config.json" <<EOF
          {
            "jdkPath": "$JAVA_HOME",
            "androidSdkPath": "$SDK_PATH"
          }
          EOF

          echo "----- ~/.bubblewrap/config.json -----"
          cat "$HOME/.bubblewrap/config.json"

          echo "----- bubblewrap doctor -----"
          bubblewrap doctor || true

      - name: Decode keystore from secret
        env:
          KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "::error::KEYSTORE_BASE64 secret is missing."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 -d > android.keystore
          ls -la android.keystore

      - name: Prepare Bubblewrap workspace
        env:
          KEYSTORE_PATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/twa-build/android.keystore
          KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.KEY_ALIAS }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p twa-build
          cp android.keystore twa-build/android.keystore
          if [ -f twa-manifest.json ]; then
            cp twa-manifest.json twa-build/twa-manifest.json
          fi

      - name: Bubblewrap init Android project
        run: |
          cd twa-build
          # Pipe `yes ""` to auto-accept every interactive prompt (Domain, URL path,
          # App name, icon URL, theme color, etc.) using the defaults that bubblewrap
          # derives from the supplied web manifest.
          yes "" | bubblewrap init \
            --manifest="https://rameshwarsahu2014bpmjarwe1694-hue.github.io/gdsnotes/manifest.json" \
            --directory=.
          echo "---- Files after init ----"
          ls -la
          echo "---- twa-manifest.json (post-init) ----"
          cat twa-manifest.json | head -60 || true

      - name: Patch signingKey in twa-manifest.json
        env:
          KEYSTORE_PATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/twa-build/android.keystore
          KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.KEY_ALIAS }}
        run: |
          cd twa-build
          node -e "
            const fs = require('fs');
            const path = 'twa-manifest.json';
            const m = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path, 'utf8'));
            m.signingKey = m.signingKey || {};
            m.signingKey.path = process.env.KEYSTORE_PATH;
            m.signingKey.alias = process.env.KEY_ALIAS || 'my-key-alias';
            fs.writeFileSync(path, JSON.stringify(m, null, 2));
            console.log('Patched signingKey ->', m.signingKey);
          "
          cat twa-manifest.json | head -40

      - name: Bubblewrap build (signed APK + AAB)
        env:
          KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          cd twa-build
          printf "%s\n%s\n" "$KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" "$KEY_PASSWORD" | bubblewrap build --skipPwaValidation
          echo "---- Build artifacts ----"
          find . -maxdepth 4 \( -name "*.apk" -o -name "*.aab" \) | sort

      - name: Locate output artifacts
        id: artifacts
        run: |
          cd twa-build
          APK_PATH=$(find . -maxdepth 4 -name "app-release-signed.apk" | head -n1)
          if [ -z "$APK_PATH" ]; then
            APK_PATH=$(find . -maxdepth 4 -name "*.apk" | head -n1)
          fi
          AAB_PATH=$(find . -maxdepth 4 -name "*.aab" | head -n1)
          echo "apk_path=twa-build/${APK_PATH#./}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "aab_path=twa-build/${AAB_PATH#./}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Found APK: $APK_PATH"
          echo "Found AAB: $AAB_PATH"

      - name: Upload APK artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: gdsnotes-signed-apk
          path: ${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.apk_path }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Upload AAB artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: gdsnotes-signed-aab
          path: ${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.aab_path }}
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Show SHA256 fingerprint (for assetlinks.json)
        env:
          KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.KEY_ALIAS }}
        run: |
          keytool -list -v \
            -keystore android.keystore \
            -alias "$KEY_ALIAS" \
            -storepass "$KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" | grep -E "SHA256|SHA1" || true

      - name: Create GitHub Release (optional)
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.release == 'true'
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: apk-${{ github.run_number }}
          name: GDS Notes APK build ${{ github.run_number }}
          files: |
            ${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.apk_path }}
            ${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.aab_path }}
          generate_release_notes: true
